name: Amplitude
tagline: Product analytics APIs for events, cohorts, charts, and experiments.
shortDescription: Amplitude provides analytics APIs for event upload, cohorts, annotations, exports, dashboards, feature flags, and experiments.
agentSummary: Agents can upload events, export cohorts, and inspect product analytics with scoped keys and privacy controls.
bestFor: Product analytics, cohorts, event pipelines, experiments, and usage reporting.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Analytics data can include PII; data governance and read/write scopes need review. Verify official docs, pricing, rate limits, permissions, and production side effects before delegating account-changing actions to an agent. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Account setup or elevated access may require vendor, admin, or compliance approval before an agent can operate independently.
pricingSummary: Public plan pricing with usage and feature limits.
authModel: API keys, secret keys, management API keys, OAuth for some integrations.
browserSupport: Dashboard is essential for chart and cohort review.

capabilities.detail: Analytics APIs include event upload, cohorts, annotations, exports, dashboards, and management APIs.
Docs cover analytics, APIs, SDKs, experiments, and data governance.
Pricing is public by plan but enterprise usage can vary.
Dashboard is essential for chart and cohort review.
